properties.name: align-content
properties.description: Controls alignment of content along the cross axis.

properties.name: align-items
properties.description: Controls alignment of items along the cross axis.

properties.name: align-self
properties.description: Overrides cross-axis alignment for one item.

properties.name: animation-duration
properties.description: Sets the duration of an animation cycle.

properties.name: border
properties.description: Shorthand for border width, style and color.

properties.name: border-radius
properties.description: Rounds the corners of an element.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: Offsets a positioned element from the bottom edge.

properties.name: box-shadow
properties.description: Adds shadow effects around an element.

properties.name: box-sizing
properties.description: Defines how width and height are calculated.

properties.name: cursor
properties.description: Sets the cursor shown over an element.

properties.name: display
properties.description: Sets an element's inner and outer display types.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Applies graphical effects such as blur or contrast.

properties.name: flex
properties.description: Shorthand for flex grow, shrink and basis.

properties.name: flex-basis
properties.description: Sets the initial main size of a flex item.

properties.name: flex-direction
properties.description: Sets the direction of flex items.

properties.name: font-family
properties.description: Sets a prioritized list of font families.

properties.name: font-size
properties.description: Sets the size of the font.

properties.name: font-weight
properties.description: Sets the weight of the font.

properties.name: height
properties.description: Sets the height of an element.

properties.name: inset
properties.description: Shorthand for top, right, bottom and left.

properties.name: justify-content
properties.description: Distributes content along the main axis.

properties.name: left
properties.description: Offsets a positioned element from the left edge.

properties.name: line-height
properties.description: Sets the height of a line box.

properties.name: object-fit
properties.description: Controls how replaced content fits its box.

properties.name: opacity
properties.description: Sets the opacity of an element.

properties.name: order
properties.description: Sets the order of a flex or grid item.

properties.name: outline
properties.description: Shorthand for outline width, style and color.

properties.name: pointer-events
properties.description: Controls whether an element can be a pointer target.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Sets how an element is positioned.

properties.name: right
properties.description: Offsets a positioned element from the right edge.

properties.name: text-overflow
properties.description: Controls signaling of clipped inline content.

properties.name: top
properties.description: Offsets a positioned element from the top edge.

properties.name: user-select
properties.description: Controls whether text can be selected.

properties.name: visibility
properties.description: Shows or hides an element without changing layout.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Sets the width of an element.

properties.name: z-index
properties.description: Sets stack order for positioned elements.
